Package com.codeborne.selenide

Record Class BrowserState

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.codeborne.selenide.BrowserState
@Desugar public record BrowserState(String origin, List<org.openqa.selenium.Cookie> cookies, Map<String,String> localStorage, Map<String,String> sessionStorage) extends Record
State of a browser for one origin: cookies, localStorage and sessionStorage. 

 BrowserState state = webdriver().getBrowserState();
 String json = state.toJson();
 ...
 webdriver().restoreBrowserState(BrowserState.fromJson(json));
Since:
7.19.0
